name: New York
limitations: All eight dimensions and31 subpillars reviewed, not fully measured. Seven conditional60 judgments andRES40 give a conditional centre58; every score requires the stated assumptions. No global ranking, reliable exclusion bound, zero imputation or healthy-person lifespan benefit. Rejecting a necessary assumption restores that dimension to unknown and removes the centre. FUA, jurisdictions, study cohorts and service areas differ.

dimensions.rationale: Completed drainage work, FY2025 maintenance and scoped actualJuly2025 storm performance, FY2024 Stamford gate operation, and2026 snow clearing/placements support operating protection. Actual heat, NJ flood and cold harms, home cooling/aid gaps, unfinished works and old-building/smoke vulnerability remain. Facilities, report counts and modelled avoided losses are not whole-FUA resident outcomes.
dimensions.assumption: Accept reviewed major protection/response continuing through cutoff and being usually usable for the target resident across7244. Cross-state evidence has limited representativeness; known thermal/flood/cold gaps have not become a broader persistent ordinary-resident/essential-corridor bottleneck without usable mitigation. This is a reversible inference, not a loss-rate measurement or guarantee from income/citizenship. Reject any necessary temporal/spatial/ordinary-protection/bottleneck assumption to restore unknown; verified important unrelieved constraints could support40, stronger multi-hazard protection and backup80.

dimensions.rationale: Actual March2026 IED danger and on-site custody/bomb response/limited evacuation then return, August synagogue harm and same-service continuation, historical cross-state gang harm with actual2026 enforcement, and completed NJNY event security/transport coordination support operating mitigation. Alleged historical injuries are not2026 new deaths or convictions; single-person bias attacks are not assigned organizational membership. Targeted harm, repeated threats, chance in avoided blast damage and non-terror rail/road disruptions remain. Existing event623566 date quarantine is unchanged.
dimensions.assumption: Accept reviewed local impacts, response/restoration and cross-state coordination as indicative of usually usable ordinary life/essential corridors across7244 without wider unobserved persistent organized-violence/regional/strategic disruption. Current reach, continuity and full scope are assumptions, not complete victim rates; income/citizenship do not guarantee equal protection and targeted harms are not averaged away. Reject a necessary assumption to restore unknown; verified important continuing bottlenecks after mitigation could support40, stronger city/regional low-impact and effective response evidence80.

dimensions.rationale: Actual fiscal-2026 hospital/digital services and activated heat measures support execution. The April 2026 OIG report separates 159 fully implemented NYPD recommendations from partial implementation, acceptance in principle and rejection; its combined progress percentage is not full implementation. Public reporting is not itself service quality or whole-FUA accountability.
dimensions.assumption: Observed execution and oversight continue through the cutoff, apply to ordinary citizens across the FUA, and reviewed defects have not become a broader unmitigated institutional bottleneck. Rejecting continuity, reach or this bottleneck assumption restores unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Primary2023 PovertyTracker food-need shortfalls persist across broad non-poor income bands, with2024 consumption adjustments adding a later price-pressure signal from overlapping study cohorts rather than independent statistical confirmation. ActualJuly2026 EEAP discounts, a typical median-household energy model below6% under DOE scope, running water/food delivery and scoped storm power restoration are retained as positive counterevidence. Cutbacks are not all unmet necessities, SPM is not FPL/AMI/local median, and benefits or model assumptions are not post-aid outcomes.
dimensions.assumption: Accept actual food-need shortfalls in the reviewed non-poor income bands as indicative of an important target median-income local-citizen affordability constraint; core-city experience has limited FUA representativeness and the constraint remains important through cutoff despite actual relief. Citizenship, exact median income, NJ/CT reach and2026 post-relief need are not jointly measured. Do not presume EEAP ineffective; rejecting resident/income/scope/continuity/materiality assumptions restores unknown. Supported usual affordability and sufficiently relieved shortages could justify60; broader supply/backup/common-shock evidence80.

dimensions.rationale: The September 2026 MMR hospital chapter reports actual delivery, primary-care appointment availability and patient outcomes/experience, including 1,170,529 unique patients, a nine-day third-next adult appointment and 69.9% glycaemic control among diagnosed patients. Eligibility/method changes explain some apparent declines; crisis continuity and median-resident affordability are not fully measured.
dimensions.assumption: Dated services persist and ordinary local citizens can usually obtain clinically adequate necessary routine/specialist care under usual coverage across the FUA. NYC Care is a conditional access programme, not universal insurance; observed patients and listed benefits do not prove affordability or eligibility for the modelled resident. Rejecting these assumptions restores unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Credible early-Alzheimer trial/regulatory evidence connects to a September 2025 NYU clinician report of actual clinical lecanemab and donanemab treatment. The current clinician address point lies in the FUA, but historical treatment location/continuity remains an assumption. The 28 exact claims-address signals are independent research leads, not NYU administrations or local residents; the two non-exact signals remain review. Eligibility, costs and serious ARIA risk are retained; presymptomatic plans/trials are not completed prevention.
dimensions.assumption: The clinician-reported treatment represents local delivery, the limited disease-specific pathway is relevant to LON readiness, and services with appropriate current safety monitoring continue through the cutoff. Clinically eligible median-income citizens can usually obtain and afford diagnosis, referral, treatment and follow-up across the FUA. Rejecting locality, pathway relevance, continuity, monitoring or ordinary access restores unknown; no healthy-person lifespan benefit or universal eligibility is assumed.

dimensions.rationale: NYU FY2025 disclosures, patents and licensing establish scoped output and industry connections; FY2026 Big Apple Connect adoption and public digital delivery support actual limited diffusion. Counts span institutional and eligible-programme scopes, not the FUA population. The active-unit denominator was updated; cumulative LinkNYC subscribers are not current local residents or distinct households.
dimensions.assumption: Observed capabilities persist and provide limited industry connections and resident diffusion across the area. One university/system and targeted housing programmes are applicable partial evidence, not whole-industry representation. Independent pressure tests at every node are not a TEC tier gate. Rejecting the necessary continuity, reach or representativeness judgment restores unknown; uptake alone establishes neither a high tier nor an upper bound.

dimensions.rationale: Actual 2025 airport use, shared section-41 application conditions and national wire-capable account terms support conditional transport, legal and asset paths. FY2026 records show a 110-minute Text-To-911 outage with voice service unaffected and 12 texters notified, alongside public communication services. Announced airport shuttle/replacement projects are not completed rides or future capacity; bounce messages do not prove all texters reached help.
dimensions.assumption: Observed channels and applicable terms persist across the FUA; ordinary citizens can usually obtain and afford transport, a qualifying residence-purpose route, an approved wire-capable account/compliant destination and an accessible alternative communication channel. Applications are not approvals, and voice availability is not universal accessible backup. Rejecting ordinary eligibility, affordability, temporal/boundary applicability or alternative access restores unknown.
